title: Banks Act Directive D3/2024 — Minimum regulatory requirements relating to the deposits covered by the Corporation for Deposit Insurance and banks' fund liquidity contributions
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Minimum regulatory requirements relating to the deposits covered by the Corporation for Deposit Insurance and banks' fund liquidity contributions.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Minimum regulatory requirements relating to the deposits covered by the Corporation for Deposit Insurance and banks' fund liquidity contributions.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Minimum regulatory requirements relating to the deposits covered by the Corporation for Deposit Insurance and banks' fund liquidity contributions. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
